questions.q: The hallmark of irreversible cell injury is:
opts: Nuclear changes such as karyolysis and pyknosis
questions.why: Swelling and fatty change are reversible.

questions.q: The remedy Lachesis is prepared from:
opts: the venom of the bushmaster snake
questions.why: Topic 3, Pharmacy. Lachesis muta, the South American bushmaster.

questions.q: Constant nausea in pregnancy not relieved by vomiting, with a clean tongue, calls for:
questions.why: Persistent nausea unrelieved by vomiting with a clean tongue is the keynote of Ipecac; Nux and Ant crud have coated tongues.
Topic 6, Pathology, Microbiology and Diagnostics. Unconjugated bilirubin is not filtered into urine.

questions.q: Weakness and backache, as if the back would break, with sweating, after labour or abortion, call for:
questions.why: Kali carb: backache, sweat and weakness after confinement or miscarriage (Allen's Keynotes, Boericke).

questions.q: Raised serum alkaline phosphatase with mildly raised ALT and AST and conjugated hyperbilirubinaemia suggests:
questions.why: Topic 6, Pathology, Microbiology and Diagnostics. ALP is the marker of bile-duct obstruction; transaminases are very high in hepatitis.

questions.q: In Kent's Repertory, the second chapter, after Mind, is:
questions.why: Topic 4, Repertory. The order follows Hahnemann's schema: Mind, Vertigo, Head...

questions.q: A rubbery intravascular clot with a dark-red dependent 'currant-jelly' part and a yellow 'chicken-fat' upper part, not attached to the vessel wall, is a:
questions.why: Post-mortem clots form after death as red cells settle, giving currant-jelly and chicken-fat layers; they lack lines of Zahn and wall attachment.

questions.q: Under India's TB programme, the preferred initial test for diagnosing pulmonary TB is now:
questions.why: Nucleic acid amplification tests also detect rifampicin resistance.

questions.q: Which of the following is a sarcode?
questions.why: Sarcodes come from healthy tissues or secretions, such as Thyroidinum. Psorinum and Medorrhinum are nosodes; X-ray is an imponderable.
